symbols.name: source contraction
symbols.meaning: The left factor of the identity, a linear contraction from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors.
symbols.quote: Here $A$ is a linear map from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors and $B_0$ is a linear map from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors.

symbols.name: target contraction
symbols.meaning: The right factor of the identity, a linear contraction from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors.
symbols.quote: Here $A$ is a linear map from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors and $B_0$ is a linear map from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors.

relations.quote: It is obtained by inverting the [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) identity, which keeps both permutations.
The two maps are linear contractions, bounded in the [operator norm](operator-norm.md) by one, meaning each sends a vector to one of norm at most its input norm.
